goal: In Calibración and Pesaje (list rows + cards), action cells show icon-only buttons (no visible text) with a Play icon that toggles to Stop while the process runs, keeping existing confirm dialogs.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Calibración (list + card): no action button renders visible text ('Calibrar'/'Stop' as text); every action button is icon-only with aria-label/title. CalibrateButton (Play icon) and StopCalibrationButton (Square icon) are mutually exclusive — never both visible at once.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest CountryListRow.test.tsx / CountryCard.test.tsx assert getByRole('button', {name:'Calibrar'}) no longer matches text content (use aria-label instead); assert only one of Play/Stop is present depending on job status.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Pesaje (list + card): an icon-only Play button launches the process directly (no modal), without rendering 'Detener' or 'Procesando...' as visible text.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest WeightingCountryListRow.test.tsx / WeightingCountryCard.test.tsx: query by aria-label for the run/stop icon buttons; assert no getByText('Detener') / getByText('Procesando...') matches.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Launching a process swaps the Play icon for the Stop icon in the same slot in both views (Calibración + Pesaje); stopping or completion reverts to Play.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest: mock a running job/run and assert the Stop icon button is present while the Play icon button is absent, and vice versa when idle/completed.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Existing launch/stop confirmation AlertDialogs still appear before the action executes.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest: clicking Play/Stop opens role='alertdialog' before the mutation fires; confirming triggers startCalibration/cancelCalibration or createWeightingRun+executeWeighting/cancelWeighting.
npm test && npm run lint && npx tsc -b; Playwright smoke project via MOCK_SERVER_PORT=8000 npm run test:e2e:fast against npm run dev:e2e + npm run mock:fast.
